title: Golden reservoir + quarantine flow and hysteresis rollback for staged model flips
creator: Aisha Natarajan
description:
Problem: Current canary/A-B/shadow workflows use a single pass/fail signal from a handful of golden prompts. That leads to brittle rollbacks (false positives due to noisy prompts) and poor visibility into partial degradations (semantic drift, hallucination spike, formatting regressions).

Goal: Deliver a production-safe, multi-signal quality gate that uses a curated "golden reservoir" of prompts, weighted scorecards, and a quarantine-and-hysteresis rollback policy. The system should: (1) compute per-prompt and composite regression scores, (2) support stochastic shadow sampling and A/B bucketing, (3) quarantine problematic prompt clusters for manual review without aborting a whole rollout, and (4) perform automated rollback only when sustained, multi-metric degradation exceeds configurable hysteresis thresholds.

Scope: Build the golden reservoir service, the scorecard engine, the quarantine queue and UI hooks, metric ingestion paths into Console, and the orchestrator that enforces hysteresis-based rollback decisions. Integrate with existing rollout conductor and alerting hooks. Excludes: new model architectures, training-time fixes, and enterprise-specific per-tenant juries (phased work).

Design notes / trade-offs: We deliberately accept additional compute for richer scorecards (BLEU-like, NER/intent coverage, hallucination heuristics, and prompt-level semantic similarity) to reduce false positive rollbacks. We will keep default reservoir sizes small (<= 2k prompts) to bound cost and provide a tuning knob for enterprise customers. Per-customer threshold overrides will be implemented as a config later (Phase 2).

High-level flow:
1) Golden reservoir service stores prompt metadata, semantic embeddings and provenance.
2) When a rollout starts, orchestrator pulls a stratified sample from reservoir plus live shadow samples.
3) Scorecard engine computes per-prompt delta vs baseline (token-level, semantic-sim, safety flags).
4) Composite score aggregates weighted signals and compares to dynamic thresholds (short window alarms + sustained-window hysteresis).
5) If composite alarm fires transiently, prompts move to quarantine for inspector review and automatic logging.
6) If alarms persist beyond hysteresis windows and affect multiple orthogonal metrics, orchestrator triggers auto-rollback.

Deliverables: design document, golden reservoir service + API, scorecard engine implementation, console dashboard for quarantine and metrics, orchestrator policy implementation, end-to-end integration tests, rollout runbook and postmortem template.
tasks: Implement golden reservoir schema and CRUD API
Implement prompt sampler for stratified shadow/canary pulls
Scorecard engine: implement similarity, hallucination, and formatting checks
Integrate composite scoring into rollout orchestrator
Quarantine queue: backend + Console UI hooks
Hysteresis policy: short/medium/windows and multi-metric aggregation
E2E tests with synthetic regressions and load profile
Dashboard: per-prompt, per-metric heatmap and time-series
Runbook and on-call playbook for manual overrides
comments: 2026-02-12 - Aisha: Kickoff meeting. Agreed to prioritize multi-metric composite over single-threshold gating to reduce noisy rollbacks. Action: Marco to prototype delta scoring (semantic sim + token diffs).

2026-02-20 - Marco: Prototype complete. Early results show that semantic similarity + hallucination heuristic drops false positives by ~40% on internal regression corpus. Pushed PR for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-orchestrator/pull/412

2026-02-25 - PM review (Lina): Request to add per-customer override flags and an enterprise opt-out for quarantine automation. We scoped overrides to Phase 2 to keep cut small. Documented in design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ML/Golden+Reservoir+Design
2026-03-02 - Design feedback (Jonah): Suggested adding 'prompt-family' clustering to avoid quarantining many near-duplicate prompts. Will add a clustering pass post-sampling.

2026-03-08 - SRE review: Performance note - scoring path needs GPU batch inference for embedding similarity at scale. Plan: use vector-search service and batch embedding RPCs. Added dependency to infra ticket ENG-90412 for vector-store scaling.

2026-03-11 - Marco: Deployed alpha to staging for internal canary tests. Observed two intermittent alarms tied to a single prompt; quarantine flow worked and prevented a blanket rollback. Preparing metrics for leadership demo.
2026-03-12 - Aisha: Approved moving to extended canary in prod-1 region for 48h, with manual rollback enabled and auto-rollback still off until hysteresis fine-tuning complete.
risks: Compute cost increase if reservoir/sample sizes are too large
False negatives if golden reservoir lacks coverage for niche customer prompts
Latency impact on canary path if scoring isn't batched appropriately
Overfitting thresholds to internal corpora causing customer-facing mismatches
acceptance_criteria: Alpha run yields <= 3 false-positive rollbacks in synthetic regression suite over 72h
Quarantine UI surfaces prompt clusters and allows inspector to mark action (ignore/require-fix/rollback)
Orchestrator executes hysteresis policy: auto-rollback only after sustained multi-metric failures (configurable windows)
End-to-end tests simulate shadow + canary traffic without exceeding latency SLOs by >10% in staging
